Advance a deferred-execution object into its fit

Source: R/review.R
proceed.Rd

Generic for the inspect-then-fit pattern. The <flexybayes_review> method restores the RNG snapshot captured at review-object construction, runs the deferred fit via the backend driver, caches the result in-place, and returns the fit. A second call returns the cached fit.

Usage

proceed(x, ...)

# S3 method for class 'flexybayes_review'
proceed(x, ...)

Arguments

x

A <flexybayes_review> object holding the deferred fit.

...

Reserved for future deferred-execution classes.

Value

The fit object the originating call would have returned, of class flexybayes. A second call returns the cached fit.

Deprecated

proceed() is deprecated in flexyBayes 0.13.0 and will be removed in a later release. Call flexybayes() with the same arguments and review_code = FALSE, and set seed for a reproducible brms fit. A call warns with a condition of class flexybayes_deprecated.

Examples

# The direct call fits the model proceed() would have fitted. The Stan
# compile is the expensive part of running this, so the fit is given a
# small budget.
if (requireNamespace("brms", quietly = TRUE)) {
  set.seed(1)
  d <- data.frame(y = rnorm(60), x = rnorm(60), g = factor(rep(1:6, 10)))
  # \donttest{
    fit <- flexybayes(y ~ x + (1 | g), data = d, backend = "brms",
                      chains = 1L, n_samples = 200L, warmup = 100L,
                      seed = 1L)
    class(fit)
  # }
}

Inspect the full diagnostics with summary(). Silence this warning via options(flexyBayes.silence_convergence_warning = TRUE).
